# ezghcloud_firewall (Data Source)

Look up an existing EZGH Cloud firewall by its canonical ID.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Canonical prefixed resource ID.
- `project_id` (String) Project containing the resource.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Resource description.
- `etag` (String) Strong firewall version.
- `name` (String) Resource name.
- `organization_id` (String) Organization containing the resource.
- `resource_name` (String) IAM resource name.
- `rules` (Attributes Set) Complete firewall rules. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--rules))
- `status` (String) Service status.
- `tags` (Map of String) Customer resource tags.

<a id="nestedatt--rules"></a>
### Nested Schema for `rules`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Firewall rule description.
- `direction` (String) Firewall rule direction.
- `icmp_code` (Number) Firewall rule icmp_code.
- `icmp_type` (Number) Firewall rule icmp_type.
- `peer_cidr` (String) Firewall rule peer_cidr.
- `peer_firewall_id` (String) Firewall rule peer_firewall_id.
- `ports_from` (Number) Firewall rule ports_from.
- `ports_to` (Number) Firewall rule ports_to.
- `protocol` (String) Firewall rule protocol.
